segments.speaker: Andrew
segments.text: Hey Priya, hey Marcus, thanks for hopping on. How's the week been?

segments.speaker: Priya Sharma
segments.text: Good, mostly. Busy quarter close for us, so the team has been living in the reporting module.

segments.speaker: Marcus Webb
segments.text: Yeah and that's actually the first thing I wanted to bring up.

segments.speaker: Andrew
segments.text: Sure, go ahead.

segments.speaker: Marcus Webb
segments.text: When we export the quarterly report to CSV, the header row is missing. The data is all there but the first row is just gone, so our finance scripts break when they try to map the columns.

segments.speaker: Andrew
segments.text: Hm, is that on every export or just the quarterly one?

segments.speaker: Marcus Webb
segments.text: We've only seen it on the quarterly report so far. Monthly exports look fine. It started sometime after your release two weeks ago.

segments.speaker: Priya Sharma
segments.text: It's blocking the close checklist, so it's pretty urgent for us.

segments.speaker: Andrew
segments.text: Understood, I'll flag that to the team today. Anything else on reporting?

segments.speaker: Priya Sharma
segments.text: Not a bug, but a wish. We'd love to be able to schedule reports to email themselves to a distribution list every Monday morning. Right now someone has to log in and send them manually.

segments.speaker: Andrew
segments.text: Scheduled report delivery, got it. Would a fixed weekly cadence be enough or do you need custom schedules?

segments.speaker: Priya Sharma
segments.text: Weekly would cover ninety percent of it. Monthly too, ideally, for the close pack.

segments.speaker: Marcus Webb
segments.text: Seconded. That would save Dana probably an hour every week.

segments.speaker: Andrew
segments.text: Noted. Okay, what about the SSO rollout, did the new IdP config land alright?

segments.speaker: Priya Sharma
segments.text: Mostly. Though a couple of people on Safari said they get bounced back to the login page after authenticating. They sign in with Okta, it succeeds, and then the app just shows the login screen again.

segments.speaker: Andrew
segments.text: Only Safari?

segments.speaker: Priya Sharma
segments.text: As far as we can tell. Chrome and Edge users are fine. It's maybe four or five people, all on Macs.

segments.speaker: Andrew
segments.text: Okay, that smells like a cookie thing. We'll dig in.

segments.speaker: Marcus Webb
segments.text: While we're on logins, is there any way to raise the session timeout? Not a big deal, just curious.

segments.speaker: Andrew
segments.text: It's configurable on our side, I'll just change it for your workspace after the call. What do you want, eight hours?

segments.speaker: Marcus Webb
segments.text: Eight hours is perfect, thanks.

segments.speaker: Andrew
segments.text: Done. How's the new dashboard treating everyone?

segments.speaker: Priya Sharma
segments.text: People like it. The load time grumbling has stopped since the last update.

segments.speaker: Andrew
segments.text: Great to hear.

segments.speaker: Marcus Webb
segments.text: Oh, one more on that CSV thing. Dana also noticed that when the header row is missing, the file name still says version two, so it's definitely the new exporter.

segments.speaker: Andrew
segments.text: That's useful, thanks. Same bug, extra clue.

segments.speaker: Priya Sharma
segments.text: By the way, did you all move offices? The background looks different.

segments.speaker: Andrew
segments.text: Ha, new floor, same building. Okay, anything else before we wrap?

segments.speaker: Priya Sharma
segments.text: One small thing on the invite flow. When I invite a user who already has a deactivated account, the invite email never arrives and there's no error. It just silently does nothing, which confused us for a day.

segments.speaker: Andrew
segments.text: So expected would be either it reactivates them or tells you the address is taken.

segments.speaker: Priya Sharma
segments.text: Exactly. Either is fine, silence is the problem.

segments.speaker: Andrew
segments.text: Agreed, we'll get that on the board.

segments.speaker: Marcus Webb
segments.text: That's everything from me. Same time next month?

segments.speaker: Andrew
segments.text: Same time next month. I'll send notes and the ticket links by end of day.

segments.speaker: Priya Sharma
segments.text: Perfect, thanks Andrew. Bye all.

segments.speaker: Marcus Webb
segments.text: Thanks, bye.
